COURT'S OR JUDGE'S ORDERS
07.01.2025 IA/1/2024 (Substitution Application)
IA/2/2024 (Delay Condonation Application)
In
AO No.99 of 2018
Hon'ble Vivek Bharti Sharma, J.
Present Mr. Mohd. Azim, learned counsel for
the appellant.
2. Mr. Prabhat Pande, learned counsel for
respondent no.1.
3. A Substitution Application along with Delay
Condonation Application has been filed by the
appellant to substitute the legal heirs of the
appellant as party in the memo of appeal.
4. Counsel for the applicants/legal heirs of the
appellant would submit that only an application for
substituting the legal heirs of the appellant has been
moved after death of the appellant.
5. By the time the substitution application was
filed, the suit had already stood abated and no
application for setting aside the abatement by law
has been filed.
6. Counsel for the applicants/legal heirs of the
appellant seeks permission to file application for
setting aside the abatement.
7. Heard.
8. The provisions for filing application for
setting aside the abatement has already been
provided in law, therefore, no permission is required
to be granted.
9. In the absence of application for setting aside
abatement of the appeal on behalf of the appellant,
the Appeal stands abated.
10. Accordingly, the Appeal is dismissed as
abated.
(Vivek Bharti Sharma, J.)
